meta.name: Newport Navigator
meta.area: Newport / Westport / Clew Bay / Achill, Co. Mayo

places.name: Lime Kiln House
places.desc: Your home for the week — near Burrishoole, just west of Newport, above a tidal inlet with Croagh Patrick from the kitchen window.
places.info: Eircode F28X380 · Wi-Fi (no password) · underfloor heating

places.name: Newport village
places.desc: Nearest town, ~5 min away — shops, pubs, butcher, petrol, Greenway trailhead. Fine Harry Clarke windows in the church.

places.name: Kelly's Kitchen, Newport
places.desc: Host pick — family-run, all-day home-style food, great for all the family. Closest sit-down spot. Between Kelly's butchers & Chamber's newsagent.

places.name: Grainne Uaile Pub, Newport
places.desc: Host pick — good pub lunch/supper, very family friendly with a kids' menu and outdoor seating. Over the bridge in Newport.

places.name: Nevin's Pub, Tiernaur
places.desc: Host pick — 8 min drive from the house, by the church en route to Mulranny. Popular family-run pub, good food all day. Call ahead on Sundays.

places.name: An Port Mór, Westport
places.desc: Host pick — award-winning restaurant in an alley off Bridge Street using locally sourced produce. Booking essential.

places.name: Cronin's Sheebeen (The Shebeen), Rosbeg
places.desc: Host pick — thatched pub on the Louisburgh road with stunning Clew Bay views. Famous fish chowder, great fish, kids' menu.

places.name: The Tavern Bar, Murrisk
places.desc: Host pick — award-winning gastropub at the foot of Croagh Patrick. Great crab dishes and a fun atmosphere.

places.name: Savoir Fare, Westport
places.desc: Host pick — Alain Morice's spot on Bridge Street; Irish artisan cheeses & charcuterie, wine and bread.

places.name: Sage, Westport
places.desc: Host pick — very popular restaurant on High Street, just above the Clock Tower.

places.name: The Pantry & Corkscrew, Westport
places.desc: Host pick — friendly spot with a good range of vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options.

places.name: Arno's Bistro, Westport
places.desc: Host pick — French chef Arnaud + Mayo head chef Donal; fresh local products with a French touch and a great wine list.

places.name: The Bella Vita, Westport
places.desc: Host pick — excellent Italian just up from the Clock Tower (left side), with a good wine menu.

places.name: Il Volcano, Westport
places.desc: Host pick — family-run Italian, good for families and larger groups, and good value.

places.name: Cornrua Bakery, Westport
places.desc: Host pick — prize-winning sourdough bakery near Lidl/Hotel Westport. Book loaves ahead or arrive early; coffee, jams, wine on site.

places.name: This Must Be The Place, Westport
places.desc: Host pick — coffee shop plus takeaway bread, cakes, wine, sandwiches and fruit, by the clock at the top of Bridge Street.

places.name: Aunty Nellie's Sweet Shop, Westport
places.desc: Host pick — old-style sweet shop on Bridge Street, a big hit with the kids.

places.name: Café Rua, Castlebar
places.desc: Host pick — the best food shop in Castlebar; deli with Irish cheeses, cured meats, smoked salmon, wines, cooked dishes and pre-order takeaway.

places.name: The Beehive, Keel (Achill)
places.desc: Host pick — freshly prepared food plus high-end craft & fashion, run by Patricia & Stephen Joyce. A great Achill stop.

places.name: Matt Molloy's Pub, Westport
places.desc: Westport institution owned by a member of The Chieftains — live trad music seven nights a week.

places.name: The Cobbler's Bar, Westport
places.desc: Restored historic pub in the town centre — Killary mussels, Guinness beef pie, cosy atmosphere.

places.name: The Helm, Westport Quay
places.desc: Down at Westport Quay — daily fresh fish landings and generous portions with a harbour setting.

places.name: Sheridan's (Centra), Newport
places.desc: Host pick — Newport's supermarket: freshly baked bread, wine, frozen goods, newspapers and everything for a quick shop.

places.name: Kelly's Butchers, Newport
places.desc: Host pick — excellent family-run butcher with prize-winning products, any cut on request, plus fruit/veg, jams, sauces and wines.

places.name: Circle K petrol, Newport
places.desc: Host pick — run by the Kelly family; fuel plus help with punctures or minor car issues. Also your key landmark on the drive home (bear left past it toward Achill/Mulranny).

places.name: SuperValu (O'Connors), Westport
places.desc: Host pick — big supermarket on Mill Street with a great fresh fish & shellfish counter. Stocks Keem Bay smoked organic salmon (hosts can arrange delivery to the house).

places.name: Tesco Westport
places.desc: Host pick — full-size Tesco on the edge of Westport for a big weekly shop.

places.name: Lidl Westport
places.desc: Host pick — discount supermarket in Westport, handy near Cornrua Bakery.

places.name: Doherty's (Centra), Mulranny
places.desc: Host pick — friendly Mulranny shop with a pub, petrol station and post office; handy for basics en route to Achill.

places.name: Pharmacy, Westport
places.desc: Town-centre pharmacy for holiday essentials. Check hours.

places.name: Great Western Greenway (Newport)
places.desc: Host pick — 42 km traffic-free cycle/walk trail on an old railway line, Westport–Newport–Mulranny–Achill. The Newport→Achill section is especially scenic. Check the wind direction first!

places.name: Shore walk from the house
places.desc: Host pick — walk down the drive and turn right along the small road; it takes you right down to the shore. A lovely short stroll on the doorstep.

places.name: Western Way (from the house)
places.desc: Host pick — for a longer, more challenging walk; the Western Way is accessible directly from the house.

places.name: Doogort beaches, Achill
places.desc: Host pick — north Achill has two Blue Flag beaches: Silver Strand at the foot of Slievemore and the vast Golden Strand with its dunes and wild grasses.

places.name: Bertra Beach, Murrisk
places.desc: Blue-Flag sandy spit near Murrisk, ~25 min away — safe swimming with Croagh Patrick behind.

places.name: Old Head Beach, Louisburgh
places.desc: Sheltered Blue-Flag beach with woodland behind, near Louisburgh — lovely for families.

places.name: Carrowniskey Beach
places.desc: Wilder surf beach past Louisburgh — good waves and big Atlantic skies.

places.name: Croagh Patrick
places.desc: Ireland's holy mountain — a 2–3 hr there-and-back climb with panoramic Clew Bay views. Start at the Murrisk car park.

places.name: Mulranny Beach & causeway
places.desc: Blue-Flag beach with a boardwalk across the saltmarsh, ~30 min north along Clew Bay.

places.name: Burrishoole Abbey & Lough
places.desc: Atmospheric ruined friary on a tidal lough just past Newport — signposted on the drive home; a short, scenic stop.

places.name: Doolough Valley
places.desc: Hauntingly beautiful mountain drive between Louisburgh and Leenane — one of Ireland's great scenic roads.

places.name: Westport House
places.desc: Host pick — 300-year-old estate; buy a day pass for the train, swan pedalos and the ever-popular log flume. Great with children.

places.name: Mulranny Park Hotel — pool & leisure
places.desc: Host pick — refurbished railway hotel with fab bay views; leisure centre with pool, hot tub and sauna. A great rainy-day distraction for kids. Day pass or multi-visit ticket; call ahead re: how busy it is.

places.name: Atlantic Drive, Achill
places.desc: Host pick — signposted right just beyond Achill Sound; spectacular coastal loop (dramatic in any weather), passing the fishing village of Dooega.

places.name: Westport Woods Riding Centre
places.desc: Host pick — lovely beach rides; pick-up point at the Westport Woods Hotel (head through town toward the Quays).

places.name: Clew Bay fishing — Darragh Magee
places.desc: Host pick — custom catamaran for leisure and fishing trips on Clew Bay, based in Newport. Flexible and experienced; trips to suit your party, weather allowing.
places.info: Number may be incomplete in guide

places.name: Pure Magic Surf & Kite School, Keel
places.desc: Host pick — surf school and kite school in Keel, Achill; wave riding on the beach and flat-water on Keel Lake. Bring wetsuits — it can be cold!

places.name: Kildavnet Castle, Achill
places.desc: Host pick — one of Grace O'Malley's (Granuaile's) tower houses, with a historic church and cemetery on the small harbour near the Atlantic Drive.

places.name: Pirate Adventure Park
places.desc: Family attraction in the Westport House grounds — pirate ship, zip lines and adventure play.

places.name: Westport Adventure Park
places.desc: Zip-lining, archery and outdoor activities about 15 min from town, near Murrisk.

places.name: Clare Island ferry (Roonagh Pier)
places.desc: Departure pier for Clare Island and Inishturk — a great quieter day trip out into Clew Bay.

places.name: Achill Island (Keem Bay)
places.desc: Ireland's largest island via a bridge — Keem Bay's Blue-Flag beach (dolphins often seen), Keel's 3 km strand and dramatic cliffs, ~50 min drive.
places.plan: ⭐ MUST-DO. Make it a full day — combine with the Atlantic Drive, Keel beach, The Beehive, and Kildavnet Castle (all pinned nearby).

places.name: Museum of Country Life
places.desc: Free national museum at Turlough Park near Castlebar — a good indoor option for a rainy day, ~30 min.

places.name: Ballintubber Abbey
places.desc: 800-year-old abbey, in continuous use since 1216 — a peaceful historic stop ~25 min away.

places.name: Mulranny Golf Club
places.desc: Host pick — scenic 9-hole links on the coast with spectacular views of Croagh Patrick and Clew Bay. Trolleys €3; competitions most Sat/Sun (call ahead).
places.plan: 👍 Our easy option — relaxed 9-hole, no advance booking needed (just avoid the Sat/Sun competition times).

places.name: Westport Golf Club
places.desc: Host pick — closest to home. Championship parkland course just outside Westport on the Newport road, with Croagh Patrick and Clew Bay views.
places.plan: 📅 Close to home — but we need to book a tee time in advance.

places.name: Carne Golf Links, Belmullet
places.desc: Host pick — world-renowned 18-hole dunes links, a good hour's drive but well worth it. Club house with food & bar.
places.plan: 📅 Denis is a member here — coordinate with him and plan this one well in advance (~1 hr drive).

places.name: Enniscrone Golf Club
places.desc: Host pick — another fantastic 18-hole coastal challenge, about an hour's drive away.
places.plan: On the recommendation list — a possible 18-hole day trip (~1 hr).

places.name: Achill Golf Club, Keel
places.desc: Quirky links course out on Achill Island — a round with a road-trip attached.

places.name: Castlebar Golf Club
places.desc: Well-regarded parkland course near Castlebar, about 30 min east.
